usage: icebath logs [-h] [-n LINES] [-f] [--level LEVEL] [--session ID] [--since TIME]
                    [--component NAME]
                    [log_name]

View, tail, and filter agent.log / errors.log / gateway.log / gui.log / desktop.log / update.log / desktop-update-handoff.log

positional arguments:
  log_name           Log to view: agent (default), errors, gateway, gui, desktop, update, handoff,
                     or 'list' to show available files

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  -n, --lines LINES  Number of lines to show (default: 50)
  -f, --follow       Follow the log in real time (like tail -f)
  --level LEVEL      Minimum log level to show (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
  --session ID       Filter lines containing this session ID substring
  --since TIME       Show lines since TIME ago (e.g. 1h, 30m, 2d)
  --component NAME   Filter by component: gateway, agent, tools, cli, cron, gui

Examples:
    icebath logs                    Show last 50 lines of agent.log
    icebath logs -f                 Follow agent.log in real time
    icebath logs errors             Show last 50 lines of errors.log
    icebath logs gateway -n 100     Show last 100 lines of gateway.log
    icebath logs gui -f             Follow gui.log in real time
    icebath logs desktop -f         Follow desktop.log (Electron app boot/backend)
    icebath logs update             Show last 50 lines of update.log (icebath update mirror)
    icebath logs handoff            Show last 50 lines of desktop-update-handoff.log
    icebath logs --level WARNING    Only show WARNING and above
    icebath logs --session abc123   Filter by session ID
    icebath logs --component tools  Only show tool-related lines
    icebath logs --since 1h         Lines from the last hour
    icebath logs --since 30m -f     Follow, starting from 30 min ago
    icebath logs list               List available log files with sizes
